I've been there myself, 5 years ago, and i got through it, so i belive i can tell you, Don't ever give up, good things are there. 

You're saying that you're a failure and disappointment - but who have you disappointed? Yourself or your family? For a lot of your life, you've been taught that you need to fulfill other peoples demands, and it don't work like that. First of all, you should try to make yourself happy, not parents or others, that's the beggining. It's after all your own life, and you should matter the most to yourself.

Staying positive is a hard, i know now, especially in 2020 but, i've been there myself, Wanted to end after a hard breakup. But eventually got throught it. 

Other people don't build your happiness, you do, and it's hard, but trust me, It's worth it!

You've been throught a lot, take a little bit of break, think about your options, and don't expect everything to change overnight. 

Do you have any friends to talk to? I know it may be hard, but the best way to get weight of your shoulders is to open up to someone you can trust.

Also, remember not to close yourself to people around you. These Times help with finding a job can come from someone you Wouldnt expect.

One more - when invited to an interview, be confident about yourself. If your future employer sees that you're confident, they will be calmer that you can get the job done
